headline: Chip Stocks Slide on AI 'Casino' Warning; Fed Outlook Mixed, Geopolitical Tensions Persist
summary: Nasdaq ended down as chipmakers fell, influenced by warnings about AI investing. Fed officials presented a mixed outlook on future rate hikes, while inflation data is expected to show acceleration. Geopolitical tensions persist with Trump's diesel deal and US policy discussions.
